business_problem: A safer gaming environment To manage the complex task of tracking as many as 40 million transactions across networks daily, Kinectify created a robust AML platform built on Microsoft Azure .
solution_summary: Kinectify modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Fabric, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Fabric and related services unify streaming, lake, warehouse, and BI capabilities so analysts and frontline teams can query fresher data without stitching together separate products. This powerhouse of data management and analysis uses the cutting-edge capabilities of Azure to integrate data points from its wide range of sources to detect suspicious activities quickly and efficiently. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.
